lines.text: Pirate costume? She understood the assignment.

data.define: Used to praise someone who did exactly what was needed, with style.

example.text: Pirate costume? She understood the assignment.

misuse.text: Don't say it when someone missed the task.

publish.title: What does "understood the assignment" mean?
publish.value: Understood the assignment = Did it perfectly. Example: "Pirate costume? She understood the assignment." (very casual English, US).
